verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's first-party docs describe a hosted, official MCP server that gives AI assistants direct access to Mixpanel data. Once connected, an agent can query events, funnels, flows, retention and session replays in natural language and use tools such as Create-Dashboard; a probe confirms the official MCP documentation page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, and documented setup/auth details in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Mixpanel provides a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI assistants direct access to your Mixpanel data.
Once connected, you can query events, funnels, flows, retention, session replays, and more using natural language — no dashboard navigation required.
Create-Dashboard | Create a new dashboard with text cards and reports
official MCP server documented at https://docs.mixpanel.com/docs/mcp
